about: The UI's view model of game-wide data, the Data of the main menu's pages (Data.SkipSplashScreen in Pages/SplashScreen.xaml).

evidence.says: the Noesis property SkipSplashScreen of the view model (macOS gui::VMGameData::GetSkipSplashScreen); Pages/SplashScreen.xaml binds Data.SkipSplashScreen in a DataTrigger that runs its CloseSplashAnim storyboard

at the press-any-key page (up --splash) setting the SplashScreen widget's DataContext.Data.SkipSplashScreen = true from client Lua closed the prompt at once and the main menu opened (GK.Gui.Stuck went from splash to mainmenu, game state Menu)
code:gui::VMGameData::VMGameData registers its Noesis properties by name
